summary: Flutter now matches web when a voice channel is closed: shows the dedicated closure status, hides the prejoin roster and join controls, preserves an explicitly selected screen viewer, and offers a leave action to an already connected participant. Widget regressions cover disconnected and connected presentation; physical cross-platform acceptance remains open.

checks.name: Test-first closed-admission body regression
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name "announces prejoin roster loading and errors as live status"
checks.observation: The new assertion first failed because Flutter did not render the web-equivalent closure status. After implementation, the test confirms the status role, hides prejoin copy and listener join controls, and shows the leave action in a connected closed-channel state.

checks.name: Full Flutter suite and analyzer
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub && flutter analyze --no-pub
checks.observation: All 326 Flutter tests pass and flutter analyze reports no issues.

checks.name: Windows/macOS/Android runtime and screen-reader acceptance
checks.observation: No physical closed-channel room was available. Runtime screenshots, the active-user leave action, selected-stream retention, and TalkBack/VoiceOver/NVDA behavior remain unverified on devices.

remaining: Verify closed-admission copy/layout, focus/live announcement, active-user leave behavior, and selected-stream retention against web on macOS, Windows, and Android.
